description: Disconnected volumes have no Service. Omit the non-null service selection and make the member optional so volumeInstance parses for unattached volumes.

patches.value:
query volumeInstance($id: String!) {
  volumeInstance(id: $id) {
    createdAt
    currentSizeMB
    deletedAt
    environment {
      canAccess
      canvasGroupRefs
      configEtag
      createdAt
      deletedAt
      id
      isEphemeral
      name
      projectId
      unmergedChangesCount
      updatedAt
    }
    environmentId
    externalId
    id
    isPendingDeletion
    mountPath
    region
    serviceId
    sizeMB
    state
    volume {
      createdAt
      id
      name
      projectId
    }
    volumeId
  }
}
